notes.title: 新关卡现已开放 - New Levels Now Accessible
notes.content:
现在游戏中有新的关卡可供您使用。跳上传送门并按 A 或 [空格键] 扭曲到阶段之间的随机传送门。我希望您喜

There are now new levels accessible to you in the game. Hop on a portal and press A or [spacebar] to warp to random portals among the stages. I hope you enjoy the new update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016433/ae5a55ce2a5ab85e067b24dba3697406dbb30c0c.png[/img]

notes.title: Sorry, fixed again!
notes.content: Now the game boots, and textures are fixed, sorry for the hiccup!

notes.title: Hey we fixed the textures in Soul Symphony
notes.content: Check it out! We fixed the texture loading bug, it makes it a lot more playable, thanks for pointing this out!
